name: Breaking the Code
label: Quest
description: Breaking the Code: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: I think I can formulate an elixir that will allow us to more readily decipher the glyphs and language of the silithid and Qiraji! What do I need? Glad you asked! I need brains! More specifically, a brain from each silithid type that inhabit the hives. Bring me brains and Rutgar's work might not be for naught.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Go play with the monkey, kid. I don't have time for this.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Outstanding! Don't wander off too far, kid. We might need you to take on another task or two.
